name: Ur of the Chaldeans

identification.note: Widely identified with Tell el-Muqayyar in southern Iraq, though some scholars propose a northern Mesopotamian location instead.

related_people.name: Abraham
related_people.role: left this city with his father Terah at the start of the journey to Canaan

related_people.name: Lot
related_people.role: set out from this city with his grandfather Terah and his uncle Abram

related_people.name: Sarah
related_people.role: left this city with Abram and Terah for the land of Canaan

description: Abraham's family's original home before they migrated toward Canaan and settled partway in Haran (Genesis 11:28-31). God later reminded Abraham that He was the one who brought him out of Ur (Genesis 15:7; Nehemiah 9:7).
